0022600143.text: The Clippers (1-2, 1-0 at home, on a two-game losing streak) host the Lakers (3-0, on a three-game winning streak), with the Clippers 3rd in the Pacific and 2 games back, 9th in the West, and the Lakers 1st in the Pacific and 3rd in the West. The season series stands at 0-1 in favor of the Lakers in 2026-27, after a 125-117 Clippers loss in Los Angeles on October 23, and the two teams split their four meetings 2-2 in 2025-26. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while the Lakers are without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation).
